name: Earnings Desk
description: Writes numbered earnings tearsheets stripped of promotional language and tracks a list of tickers so a report lands when one of them reports. Output arrives as a Word document, which fits investors who file and annotate writeups rather than skim them on a phone.

official.title: Earnings Desk by Sachiv
official.description: Builds numbered, no-hype earnings tearsheets and keeps a ticker watch list. For investors who want a Word writeup when a watched name prints.
